inputPolicy: Connected Mandarin preserves natural phrasing and sandhi. Unambiguous lexical targets may use native spelling; explicitly selected nondefault readings keep lexical controls. Neutral targets may retry romanized spelling; de may use the phonemically identical 的 with recorded provenance. Quoted default readings may use a short punctuation boundary without adding spoken syllables. Never concatenate recordings. Explicit authored contextual controls preserve selected readings where native synthesis repeatedly misreads them. All explicitly authored word practices can retry the selected lexical pinyin; phonemic quoted targets can use a short boundary without additional syllables. Native 一/不 prefixes preserve connected-speech sandhi when a following lexical syllable is controlled. For quoted or isolated 乒, the clear-reading retry supplies explicit posterior-nasal guidance; all other inputs keep the same strategy. Selected 乒 practices try lexical phonemes before native spelling. Isolated characters may retry quoted lexical phonemes; quotation marks change presentation only, never add spoken words. For explicitly authored quoted lexical targets, a variant can remove silent quotation marks while retaining native default readings or selected phonemes; no syllables are added or removed.
